page.dashboard.title: Executive Dashboard
page.dashboard.description: Operational exposure across the plant network, and what is being done about it.
page.work.title: Work Manager
page.work.description: Every detected operational case, in one queue — triage it, own it, execute it, verify it.
page.myWork.title: My Work
page.myWork.description: Everything assigned to you, ordered by priority and due date.
page.actions.title: Action Center
page.actions.description: Everything that needs a decision today — assigned work, SLA warnings, approvals, escalations and what the platform recommends next.
page.analytics.title: Execution Analytics
page.analytics.description: How the operation is performing at closing the exceptions it detects — by plant, by owner and over time.
page.reports.title: Reports
page.reports.description: Scheduled and on-demand executive and audit reporting, composed from the same figures the dashboard reads.
page.admin.title: Administration
page.admin.description: Users, roles, plant scoping, assignment routing, SLA thresholds and priority weights — with a live preview of what each change would do.
page.audit.title: Audit Log
page.audit.description: Append-only record of every state change, assignment, verification decision and configuration edit across the network.
page.playbooks.title: Playbooks
page.playbooks.description: Reusable corrective-action templates per exception type, with the measured effect of each on resolution time and recurrence.
page.connectors.title: Connector Health
page.connectors.description: Enterprise data ingestion status, run history, deduplication and dead-letter replay — the integration layer that turns signals into cases.

cd.approveHint: The outcome holds against the measurement window. The case is verified.

cd.rejectHint: The corrective action did not resolve the condition. Returns to the owner.

cd.priorityHint: Matches the scored band. Overriding is recorded as a manual decision.
cd.statusHint: Verified and closed states are set by the reviewer, not by hand.

cd.acceptanceHint: The acceptance criteria the reviewer will check this against.

cd.commentHint: Add context, a decision, or a question. Use @ to notify someone.
